description: Make official Modal Carbon 8 firmware boot on a Cobalt 8 (model id 0x19) unit.

provenance.source_images: Official Modal Electronics firmware files, supplied by the user. Not included in this repository and not obtainable through it.
provenance.confirmed: Carbon 8 boots after applying this patch set (2026-10-18)

edits.what: cmp r3,#0x1d -> cmp r3,#0x19  (model gate). clean VMA 0x437EDA, padded VMA 0x42A1C5

notes: Only the packet model byte is changed on master/slave; their payloads are untouched.
The single meaningful engineering change is one instruction (the model gate compare) in the panel image.
Firmware revision 1-2 and other revisions have different layout/offsets and are NOT supported by this patch file.
